title: Adaptive async experiment progress heartbeat
description: Changes running experiment progress from a fixed interval to policy-driven adaptive reporting for the Process panel.
changes: Read meta.progress_policy from async experiment job metadata.
Support adaptive intervals, fixed intervals, off mode, time milestones, log milestones, and quiet alerts.
Keep completion and failure notifications prioritized over running progress.
Tell the agent not to produce standalone user-facing replies for running progress; the frontend Process panel displays it.

rollback.notes: Restore fixed ARC_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS progress behavior if adaptive reporting regresses.
